column3: Saori Route ・ A Stalemate
Anyway, hang in there. Go for it, okay?
...I am grateful for everything.
I said it's fine. Don't worry about it.
Mmm... please don't suddenly pet me! That tickles-!
Ah, sorry.
Petting a young flower such as I like a puppy... You really do not understand the heart of a maiden!
Calling yourself a flower with those spiral glasses on is a bit much...
...Just now, you just thought of something rude, right?
Eh? Uhh...
It is no use playing dumb!
I know because I read your mind!
Really!?
Just kidding.
You!!
But-
Even I can do feminine things.
If you can, then why don't yo-.
Huh...?
Heh... How about it Kyousuke-shi?
Just... as a show of my gratitude...
Eh? Eh? Ehh?
This soft feeling... could it be...?
Fufufu...
T-That was...?
You do not need to be so flustered, right? Or...
...Was I... bothering you?
Of course... not.
It just... surprised me a little.
Ah... Is that so...?
...Thank goodness, you do not loath me.
Saori showed a smile from her heart.
Reflecting off the evening sun, Saori's face glistened beautifully.
Unprepared, my heart skipped a beat... But hey, that's not even fair...
So with that, please wait a while for the good news.
I will be certain to return with some good news.
Yeah... I'm looking forward to it, Saori.
Understood!
